title: [CI] : linux machine aarch64 test take more longer compare to x86_64
body:
```The x86_64 test needs only 25 minutes so I am confused why aarch64 got so much slower, they used to be around the same time. Of course our tests should not take that long so we really need to figure out what is actually causing this slow down.```  
from issue [28299](https://github.com/containers/podman/pull/28299
)

I think better to investigate what is causing the slowdown, 60 mins tests could be less idea.

comments.body: A friendly reminder that this issue had no activity for 30 days.

Hi @timcoding1988, I’ve been investigating #28300 and wanted to ask if I could work on it.

I found that @Luap99 measured VM boot+stop cycles at ~30s on x86_64 vs ~50s on AArch64, and the AArch64 tests on Mac/libkrun were much faster, which points toward the host/runner side.

I also noticed that after the CI migration, the AArch64 machine test is currently disabled because the ARM runner doesn't have virt enabled, while the x86_64 machine test is now also approaching the 60-minute timeout.

I’d like to investigate the per-test timing breakdown and determine whether the slowdown is caused by the runner/virtualization environment, CPU performance, or specific machine tests.

Would it be okay for me to investigate and work on this?
